name: nino-two-dose-medication

userStories.title: Package helpers + pending-dose resolver sensor
userStories.description: In packages/people/nino/medication_reminder/nino_daily_medication_reminder.yaml, replace the three single-dose helpers with paired per-dose helpers (2 taken booleans, 2 escalated booleans, 2 timers, 2 input_datetimes) and add sensor.nino_medication_pending_dose. Declarative layer only; task-2 adds the logic that consumes it. READ FIRST: the target file; packages/leak_monitoring.yaml and packages/outdoor_lighting.yaml (template: inside a package precedent); packages/mudroom/garage_entry_door/garage_entry_door_auto_lock.yaml:78 (today_at precedent); packages/CLAUDE.md. RESOLVER RULE, exactly: a dose is in play if untaken AND (its scheduled time has passed today OR its snooze timer is active); among in-play doses return the one with the LATEST scheduled time; tie goes to the higher dose number; no in-play doses or any unavailable input returns the literal string 'none'. MITIGATIONS: (1) Dose 1 initial MUST be '07:00:00' — not 08:00:00 (captured pre-migration value, kept for rollback only) and not 07:30:00 (superseded draft). (2) restore: true on both timers is load-bearing — it is what makes task-2's restart durability work. (3) The sensor must never go unknown/unavailable; input_datetime entities read unknown during HA startup and an unguarded today_at(states(...)) raises, which would silently break both the ZHA button and the wake-up deferral. (4) Order by latest scheduled time, never by timer-active; timer-active only widens membership. Ordering by timer priority is a real bug the review caught.

userStories.title: Dose-aware reminder automation, script, reset, button, and file rename
userStories.description: Rewrite the three automations and script.nino_medication_taken as dose-aware, and rename the file to nino_medication_reminder.yaml. Reminder automation id becomes nino_medication_reminder (alias 'Nino Medication Reminder'); the reset and shortcut automations KEEP their existing ids (nino_medication_reminder_reset, nino_medication_reminder_shortcut_button) — both confirmed registered on the live host, so keeping them avoids new orphans. READ FIRST: the file as left by task-1; packages/alexa_actionable_notifications.yaml:40,50-53 (automation-level variables with trigger.*, templated target entity_id); packages/general_notifications.yaml (script contract); packages/announcements/voice_announcement.yaml; plans/nino-two-dose-medication/review.md (verified-claims table); CLAUDE.md. STRUCTURE: 5 triggers — time on each datetime (ids '1','2'), event on timer.finished for each timer (ids '1','2'), state on input_select.nino_sleep_state to 'Awake' for 5 minutes (id 'awake'). Automation-level variables: resolve dose from trigger.id, or from sensor.nino_medication_pending_dose when trigger.id == 'awake'; derive taken_boolean, snooze_timer, dose_time, tag. Conditions: dose in ['1','2'], dose untaken, dose timer idle, sleep state Awake. ACTION ORDER (this ordering IS the CRITICAL 2 fix): 1. script.voice_announcement with dose-neutral wording; 2. timer.start on the dose's timer — BEFORE the wait; 3. script.general_notification with per-dose tag nino-medication-dose-{{ dose }}; 4. wait_for_trigger 15-min timeout with three triggers (trigger: template value_template is_state(taken_boolean,'on') id 'taken'; event on push action_taken id 'taken_push'; event on push action_snooze id 'snooze'); 5. branch on wait.trigger.id — taken/taken_push call script.nino_medication_taken with the dose, snooze restarts the timer for a full 15 min, and the timeout branch is a NO-OP. MITIGATIONS: (1) CRITICAL 2 — timer.start goes BEFORE wait_for_trigger. Current code starts it only on timeout (lines 152-157), so during the 15-min wait nothing persistent records a dose in flight; any restart kills the run and the dose vanishes silently. Starting at prompt time makes it restart-durable. (2) The wait's taken trigger MUST be trigger: template, NOT trigger: state — a state trigger's entity_id cannot be templated (cv.entity_ids_or_uuids rejects it at config load). No precedent in this repo for this pattern; all 13 wait_for_trigger uses were checked. (3) Guard EVERY timer.start with is_state(taken_boolean,'off') — load-bearing for three failure modes: template trigger silently not firing, boolean flip between condition check and wait attach, duplicate parallel runs. Do not simplify away. (4) mode: parallel, max: 4, and do NOT set max_exceeded: silent. (5) Use wait.trigger.id, never trigger.id, after the wait. (6) script.nino_medication_taken must not call automation.turn_off. (7) Reset clears both taken booleans, both escalated booleans, cancels both timers, and no longer calls automation.turn_on.

userStories.title: Late-dose escalation (unmutable backstop)
userStories.description: New file packages/people/nino/medication_reminder/nino_medication_escalation.yaml. A backstop that fires when everything else has failed quietly — deliberately dumb and independent of the resolver, the parallel-run limit, and the notification policy. READ FIRST: packages/general_notifications.yaml:206-227 (THE MUTE GATE THIS MUST BYPASS); packages/ninos_room/nino_escaping/nino_escape_monitor.yaml:81 (direct-notify precedent, also for Nino); packages/people/cristina/medication_reminder/cristina_friday_medication_reminder.yaml:71-83 (direct notify with interruption-level); the file as left by task-2 for entity IDs. DESIGN: trigger is time_pattern every 15 minutes. Per-dose condition: dose untaken AND now() >= today_at(dose_time) + timedelta(hours=2) AND that dose's _escalated boolean is off. Action: call notify.ios_family DIRECTLY with data.push.interruption-level: critical, then turn on that dose's _escalated boolean. MITIGATIONS: (1) CRITICAL 1 — MUST NOT route through script.general_notification. That script hard-gates on input_select.notification_level at packages/general_notifications.yaml:206-207; when the select is 'None' it exits silently, sending nothing and logging nothing. A backstop sharing a mute switch with the system it backs up is not a backstop. (2) Use time_pattern, NOT a template trigger — a template trigger already true at HA startup never fires, so a restart during the escalation window would disable the net precisely when a restart caused the problem. (3) The _escalated booleans prevent a critical push every 15 minutes; task-2's 3am reset clears them. (4) Own file, per one-automation-one-job — this is the one place that convention applies in this package.
